g.text: One per Microsoft Entra tenant. Provides centralized governance and shared resources
Each workload has one workload landing zone consisting of all environments. Each environment consists of one or more Azure su
Platform personnel manage the platform landing zone.
Distribution and placement of application landing zone
subscriptions under the right management group
Single data lake for the organization
Common data domains are business units (Marketing, Sales, Finance) and product lines (product1, product2)
Single data catalog for all data across the organization
Data domains determine what data lands in Fabric
Data domains scan their data sources into the Data
Map, which populates the Unified Catalog.
